claim: The Jaffna thombo system tied household registration, caste/status, land, taxation and service labour to a blended Tamil-Portuguese-Dutch bureaucracy, reproducing hierarchy while also creating documentary arenas in which villagers negotiated obligations and property.
bounded_by: The two supporting works are distinct scholarly studies but share the Cambridge publishing domain. The mechanism is retained as bounded same-publisher corroboration until an independent archival or scholarly source family is added.
notes: Paper legibility is both coercive and negotiable; avoid a one-way domination model.
